methodology: Fresh process per profile/engine; alternating baseline/candidate order; GC outside timing. RSS is whole-worker peak including warmup. Retained heap holds the API result. Recovery disabled only for output-identical performance comparison; candidate default mode measured separately. No hard timing CI thresholds.
measurementNote: Final isolated run. Earlier exploratory runs excluded; a review stress probe overlapped one earlier run. No other test workloads ran during this measurement.
